title: Role Separation Helps, Conditionally: A Rubric-Sensitive Multi-Agent Large Language Model (LLM) Study of Security-Privacy Policy Decisions under Korea's PIPA
description:
Replication package for the study "Role Separation Helps, Conditionally: A Rubric-Sensitive Multi-Agent Large Language Model (LLM) Study of Security-Privacy Policy Decisions under Korea's PIPA."

Contains the confound-controlled confirmatory run (confirm_v3): a single uniform per-call output cap across all conditions, 108 Phase-1 traces, and 324 per-judge responses under both the primary and the corrected (omission-penalizing) rubrics; the full generation, judging and analysis code; frozen scenarios with SHA-256 freeze hashes; token-usage logs; and MANIFEST.sha256. English companions (scenario and prompt translations, and a data dictionary) accompany the authoritative Korean-language record.

Licensing: code (Python, shell) is released under the MIT License; data, scenarios, prompts, model outputs and documentation are released under CC BY 4.0.
